description.zh:
迁移、同步或订阅实例ID。
> 可以通过调用[查询迁移实例列表及各实例详情](~~208139~~)、[查询数据订阅实例列表及各实例详情](~~49442~~) 、[查询数据同步实例列表及各实例详情](~~49454~~)进行查询。
description.en:
The ID of the data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking instance.
> You can query the instance ID by invoking [Query the list of data migration instances and details of each instance](~~208139~~), [Query the list of change tracking instances and details of each instance](~~49442~~), or [Query the list of data synchronization instances and details of each instance](~~49454~~).
The ID of the data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking task.

description.zh: DTS实例所属地域，详情请参见[支持的地域列表](~~141033~~)。
description.en: The region in which the DTS instance resides. For more information, see [List of supported regions](~~141033~~).

description.zh:
同步方向，取值：
- **Forward**：正向，默认值。
- **Reverse**：反向。
> 当数据同步实例的拓扑类型为双向时，才可以传入**Reverse**以启动反向同步链路。
description.en:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:
- **Forward**: forward. This is the default value.
- **Reverse**: reverse.
> You can set this parameter to **Reverse** to start the reverse synchronization link only when the topology of the data synchronization instance is two-way synchronization.

description.zh:
是否无感集成（Zero-ETL）任务，取值：

- **false**：否。
- **true**：是。
description.en:
Specifies whether the node is a zero-ETL node. Valid values:

- **false**: no.
- **true**: yes.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts start-dts-job --dts-job-id l3m1213ye7l0000 --dts-instance-id dtsl3m1213ye7l0000 --synchronization-direction Forward --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zero-etl-job true --resource-group-id rg-aek2ilvoxlrdcby --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dts StartDtsJob --region cn-hangzhou --DtsJobId l3m1213ye7l0000 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-aek2ilvoxlrdcby' --ZeroEtlJob true --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DtsInstanceId dtsl3m1213ye7l0000 --SynchronizationDirection Forward
